info.title: Hisaab API
info.description: Hisaab API: dues, cash forecast, what-if scenarios, SMS and Razorpay payment matching, and a voice/text agent. All money values are strings in rupees.

post.description: Create a customer for the current business.

get.description: List the business's customers, optionally filtered by status and batch.

schema.title: Response List Customers Api V1 Customers Get

get.description: Return one customer with their invoices and payments.

patch.description: Apply only the fields the client sent to one customer.

post.description: Create one invoice per active customer for the period, skipping those already invoiced.

get.description: List the business's invoices, optionally filtered by status, customer and period.

schema.title: Response List Invoices Api V1 Invoices Get

post.description: Record a manual payment, allocate it to one invoice and persist both changes.
Create a bill; next_due_date is computed from the server's local today (date.today()).

get.description: List the business's bills ordered by name.

schema.title: Response List Bills Api V1 Bills Get

patch.description: Apply only the fields the client sent to one bill; recomputes next_due_date when due_day changes.

get.description: Return per-customer outstanding dues ordered by priority (temporary: total_due x days_late), plus totals.
Daily best / likely / worst balance, first shortfall, its causes and the assumptions.

schema.title: Response Get Forecast Api V1 Forecast Get

post.description: Same shape as GET /forecast with the changes applied, plus `baseline` (the unchanged forecast).
